content.title: Chapter 78 - PUBLIC IMPROVEMENTS — Sec. 78-34. - Defraying expenses.
content.summary:
The council shall forthwith defray any expenses theretofore accruing and appertaining
               to any project or any part thereof so ordered not to be made.
(Code 1981, § 27-35; Ord. No. 551, § 14(D), 5-14-1964)
